packageRules.description: Tauri 2 requires the GTK 0.18 native-link and type family.
sha2 0.11 removes the LowerHex implementation used for artifact revisions.
mesh-llm's log store requires rusqlite 0.40, and only one libsqlite3-sys may link sqlite3.
Upgrade virtua only with a reviewed port of its WebKit scroll patch.
Update packageManager together with the Hermit pnpm pin in bin/.
